task_name: Add My Work observability and performance verification

concerns_addressed: P3-002 is resolved at the My Work Mark done boundary: server/src/routes/my-work-router.ts:231-236 emits code=wip_limit_reached for Board WIP rejections, while client/src/components/my-work/myWorkDoneActionState.ts:57-63 now classifies only coded version_conflict/conflict 409 responses as version conflicts. Uncoded WIP 409 responses therefore render their WIP message instead of the stale-update warning.

Board and Tracker unmappable responses are source-correct: server/src/routes/my-work-router.ts:222-229 retains current board columns for Board and emits current Tracker statuses for Tracker. The real authorization integration regression asserts both exact messages, status_column_unmappable, unchanged source state, and no activity in server/src/routes/my-work.integration.authorization.ts:16-50.

Rendered non-conflict feedback remains accurate: the real MyWorkDoneAction component tests exercise both uncoded and coded WIP 409 responses and assert the WIP message, rollback, refresh, and re-enabled action in client/src/components/my-work/MyWorkDoneAction.test.tsx:114-159. Existing transient-error coverage exercises the same server-message rendering branch used by unmappable responses.

Version-conflict handling and recovery remain intact: the correction changes only the conflict predicate; the existing coded version-conflict rollback/refresh, optimistic race precedence, source/version routing, and no-write assertions remain in the audited client/server suites and are unchanged by the correction.

The correction contains exactly the five mechanically verified files, has no log.json, and leaves T11's original done_sha pinned; reviewed_sha is the newest owned correction anchor becea2ba459aa2df473c4f162573b319c9f2b2ca.

strengths: The contract change is focused: one narrow client predicate, explicit source-aware server response vocabulary, and targeted real-DB/component regressions; no duplicate mutation or fallback implementation was introduced.

The server keeps existing response ordering and transaction behavior: conflict, unmappable, and WIP results return before detail/event publication, so source writes, activity, rollback/refresh, and race precedence are unaffected.

The tests follow existing My Work integration and component patterns. Server acceptance passed 10/10, the client Mark done suites passed 17/17, and independent server Mark done unit tests passed 14/14.

Independent mechanical checks passed: mutation-routing guard, server/client typecheck, root Biome lint, and git diff --check. The commit subject is fix(my-work): align mark done error contracts and its scope excludes log/review state from the correction commit.

issues.description: Implementer concern (verbatim): "Default parallel `npm run test` caused resource contention: seven existing client tests timed out and readiness exceeded one second; targeted commands and serial client suite passed." This remains an environment-only performance-test concern because the isolated T11 server unit, real-DB integration, and client readiness commands passed independently; the serial client suite and a fresh default client run passed, and the T11 test documents its controlled boundary.
